cohort: 60 pregnant women (24 with GD, 18 with T2DM, 36 without diabetes) and their neonates
finding: Pregnant women with diabetes had lower ghrelin and proinsulin levels compared to those without diabetes, and pre-term birth appeared to influence these hormone levels in women with GD.
mod_finding: The abstract focuses on ghrelin and proinsulin levels and does not provide information about mode of delivery.
gest_age: Pre-term or term (specific gestational ages not mentioned)
birth_weight: Measured and correlated with HbA1c levels
cross-section timing: During the last week before caesarian delivery
